d:
Victor Wembanyama continues his legendary start to his career. His latest performance marks the fourth instance in NBA history of a player recording at least 50 PTS, 15 REB, and 5 BLK in a single game.
The only three players to accomplish the feat are Bob McAdoo, Anthony Davis, and Wembanyama, who has now done it twice. This is a record limited to the official blocks era, which began in the 1973–74 season.
